description: Run account-specific platform helper discovery. Available helpers: instagram.audio, linkedin.company_lookup, linkedin.recent_mentions, pinterest.boards, tiktok.creator_info, x.quota, youtube.playlists.

account_id.description: Connected social account ID when the helper needs account context.

params.description: Helper inputs. linkedin.company_lookup needs { vanity: the company vanity name or company page URL }. instagram.audio finds music and sounds for a Reel and takes { type: music or original_sound, q: search text (omit for trending), audio_id: look up one }.

platform.description: Platform hint when no account_id is supplied. Supported: instagram, facebook, tiktok, twitter, linkedin, youtube, pinterest, threads, google_business, telegram, bluesky, discord, slack, mastodon, devto, hashnode, wordpress, lemmy.

name: trigger_platform_helper
